name: Josh

origin.summary: Honors Army Staff Sergeant Joshua Hager, 29, killed in Ramadi, Iraq, on February 22, 2007, by an improvised explosive device. Overhead squats and pull-ups in a descending-ascending ladder — one of the shorter Heroes, and no gentler for it.

description: A descending 21-15-9 overhead squat ladder paired with double the pull-up reps at each step.
source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08
